theme_label_cn: 冰霜蓝主题 · 剑 · 霜华灵境·守剑人（东方仙侠绝色女剑仙）
subject_desc: a young Chinese fantasy sword immortal woman
age_phrase: a slender young woman of about twenty
watermark: cloud scrolls, frost crystals and slender sword shapes
gradient: pale frost blue at the top to a deeper slate blue lower down
hanging_elements: frosted pine branches and hanging icicles
moon_halo: a hazy full moon ringed by a pale ice-blue halo
backdrop: silhouetted snow ridges and a small tiered Chinese pavilion standing behind the figure
hair_style: gathered up into a high ponytail
hair_ornaments: small silver frost pins and a faint pale-blue sword-shaped sigil set between the brows
robe_gradient: pure white at the chest to a pale ice blue at the trailing hem
sash: carved white jade links and a silver frost chain
hold_action: {V:grip} the ancient ice-crystal sword "青霜" raised before {o}
weapon_charm: a swirling halo of frost-blue light coiling around the blade, with a cold pillar of light falling from its tip
companions: frost cranes wreathed in pale-blue sword-light
expr_desc_1: {p} eyelids sit cool and half lowered with the pupils showing beneath them, and the corners of {p} mouth curve up into a soft cool smile that never quite reaches {p} eyes
expr_desc_2: {p} head is upright but {p} lids are lowered until {p} gaze rests down and away and {p} eyes are barely open, {p} lips closed and relaxed
expr_desc_3: {p} head tips a little back, {p} lids sit low and glossy, {p} lips part loosely and colour rises on both cheeks
expr_desc_4: {p} head turns three-quarters away from the reader and {p} chin lifts, while {p} eyes turn back toward the reader over {p} shoulder
profile: 性格：清冷自持，剑心不折
喜好：雪巅问剑、煮雪烹茶、独守青霜
couplet: 我本无心，只因你入梦，便留了心。
weapon_drawing: a small drawing of the ancient ice-crystal sword
background_text: 凌霜，霜华灵境的守剑人。{T}以剑引鹤，以霜为舟，渡人出尘，却从不入旁人的江湖。看似清冷自持、游戏人间，实则剑心孤勇，只肯在雪巅独酌。{T}在灵境中种满寒松，引万千霜鹤为伴，唯独等一个敢拔剑的对手。剑声起时，霜裂千峰；剑声落处，冰消无痕。
signature: —— 一剑一鹤一浮生，梦里不知身是客。
lighting: the cold ice-blue moonlight behind thin cloud and the frost-blue glare of the blade
palette: moon white, ice blue and slate teal
